text: Sorry it's late. I'm fostering a little boy, he's 2, and his temperature just read 39.9 which is the highest I've seen on him. He threw up once earlier but he's had his water and juice since and kept it all down. I checked his neck because I read you should, and he can look right down at his toes no problem. I'm just really scared because I don't know his history much and I don't want to get this wrong.
